newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.2 billion yuan from a thin 1.2 billion yuan on Wednesday with the seven-day contract the most active.

Traders said short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, increased their lending today because of several new share issues on the domestic A share markets in the next few days.
"Securities houses and brokerages borrowed more today for trading on the A share markets, with their focus on the early-maturing contracts," said one trader.
Traders said state banks, which used to be major lenders, were mostly sidelined today, waiting for the outcome of a meeting of senior bank officials in Beijing next week.
